metadata.name: What a step needs from outside, and what it hands over
metadata.description: Two work nodes on one edge. The second one declares `external`: the price sheet it needs is fetched from a server before the session starts and materialised in the working directory under the name `as` gives it, and the proposal it writes is delivered to a folder outside only after the checks pass. That same node is marked `unsafe_to_retry`, because a delivery already made cannot be taken back. The smallest document that says what a step reaches for and what it leaves behind (t369).

nodes.description: Writes the brief the proposal answers. Declares no external I/O: everything it needs already travels with the job, and it hands nothing to anybody outside.

checks.description: The brief exists and is not empty.

nodes.description: Writes the proposal from the brief and the price sheet, and delivers it. `prices` is required by its pinned skill and produced by no ancestor: what satisfies it is the external input below, materialised in this node's working directory and in nobody else's.

checks.description: The proposal exists and is not empty — and it is checked BEFORE anything is delivered outside.

edges.description: A single exit: the brief always goes on to the proposal.
